_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Nangba Player {player_id}, {num_rounds} rounds Iterated Ultimatum Game ṭamṭa khongnangba.
Nangṭon ${pool} ṭamṭa ṭonkhomna round ṭhatlou na nangba Player {other_id} ṭonkhomna ṭamṭa split ṭhatpa.

Proposer:
  - Offer ṭhatpa: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Accepted ṭhatlou → Nangba $(pool - X) ṭonkhom, nangba ṭhatlou Player $X ṭonkhom
  - Rejected ṭhatlou → Both $0 ṭonkhom
  - Example: [Offer: $3]  ebu  'Nangṭon ṭhatpa fair ṭhajaoba. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Offer ṭhatpa ṭhatlou na [Accept] ebu [Reject] ṭhatpa
  - Example: 'Ṭhatpa reasonable ṭhajabi. [Accept]'
            'Unfair ṭhajabi. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Round {round_number} begins! ---
Player {proposer_id} proposer ṭhajabi, Player {responder_id} responder ṭhajabi.
round.offer: Round {round_number}: Player {proposer_id} ${offer} Player {responder_id} ṭonkhomna offer ṭhatpa (keeping ${keep}).
round.accepted: Player {responder_id} accepted! Round {round_number} gains: Player {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Player {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. New totals: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} rejected the offer! Round {round_number} gains: Both players +$0. Totals remain: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: প্রোপোজর অদুনা [Offer: $X] ফোর্মেত শিজিন্নদুনা ওফর অমা পীগদবনি।
invalid_move.bad_integer: ওফরগী শেনফম অসি ভেলিদ ওইবা ইন্তিজর মশীং অমা ওইগদবনি।
invalid_move.no_current_offer: হৌজিক পাউখুম পীরক্নবা ৱাফম অমত্তা লৈতে।
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder ṭonkhomna ṭhatpa ṭhatlou na [Accept] ebu [Reject] the offer.
